goalZh: 会用 There are… 说家里有几口人,用 a / an 说家人的职业
canDoZh: 能说出家里有几口人、父母做什么工作、住在哪里

newItems.noteZh: 后面跟复数名词:How many people…? How many brothers…?
people 本身就是复数,不加 s:four people。
问职业最常用这句,比 What's her job? 自然;问家人:What does your dad do?
美式 o 读 /ɑː/;part-time job 兼职(第 3 单元)。
美国大学生称呼老师一般用 Professor + 姓,不叫 Teacher。
ur 读卷舌的 /ɝː/:舌尖往后卷,不碰上颚。
重音在最后 en-gi-NEER;以元音开头,用 an:an engineer。
work 的 or 读 /ɝː/,别读成 walk /wɑːk/;She works at a hospital。
i 是短音 /ɪ/,词尾 v 要读出来;My parents live in Chengdu.;第三人称 lives。
重音在第一个音节 HOS-pi-tal;在医院工作 work at a hospital。

lines.speaker: professor
lines.text: OK, you guys. Please work with a friend.
lines.zh: 好,同学们。请找一位同学一起做。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Lei, how many people are there in your family?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: There are four: my dad, my mom, my grandma, and me.
lines.zh: 四口:我爸爸、我妈妈、我奶奶和我。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.zh: 你爸爸是做什么工作的?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: He's an engineer, and my mom is a teacher.
lines.zh: 他是工程师,我妈妈是老师。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: A teacher? That's a great job! Do they live in Chengdu?
lines.zh: 老师?那是很好的工作!他们住在成都吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes. My parents live in Chengdu, and my grandma lives with us.
lines.zh: 对。我父母住在成都,我奶奶和我们住在一起。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: What does your mom do, Sofia?
lines.zh: 你妈妈是做什么工作的,索菲亚?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: She's a nurse. She works at a hospital in Mexico.
lines.zh: 她是护士,在墨西哥的一家医院工作。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And you have two brothers and two sisters. That's a big family!
lines.zh: 你还有两个哥哥、两个妹妹。真是个大家庭!

grammar.titleZh: There are… 说几口人;职业前要加 a / an
grammar.bodyZh: 说“某处有……”用 There is(一个)/ There are(两个及以上):There are four people in my family.(我家有四口人。)这是最地道的说法,别照着中文说成 In my family have four people。问“有多少”用 How many + 复数名词:How many people are there in your family?。问职业最自然的说法是 What does your dad do?;回答时职业前一定要加 a / an:He's an engineer. She's a nurse.——中文说“他是工程师”没有“一个”,所以最容易漏;engineer 以元音开头,用 an。另外先认识:主语是 he、she 或一个人时,动词后面加 -s:she works、my grandma lives(第 3 单元系统学)。

examples.text: How many people are there in your family?
There are four people in my family.
What does your mom do? — She's a teacher.
examples.zh: 你妈妈是做什么的?——她是老师。

examples.text: My dad is an engineer. He works in Chengdu.
examples.zh: 我爸爸是工程师,他在成都工作。
